h: Nollywood mourns Francis Duru, dead at 57
p: Veteran actor Francis Duru has died at 57 after a brief illness, two years after he lost his teenage son. Old posts about his son, his wife Adokiye and an earlier video where he answered health rumours are now circulating as tributes pour in.
